newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bougyues Offshore float price 127 Ffr/shr.
newsitem.headline: Bougyues Offshore float price 127 Ffr/shr.

text.p: Bouygues Offshore, a unit of French construction company Bouygues, said on Thursday in a statement it had priced its 6.8 million global share offering at 127 francs per share.

At the end of the offering, some 40 percent of Bouygues Offshore's capital will be held by the public. This could be raised to 46 percent if the underwriters' over-allotment option to purchase an additional 1.02 million shares is exercised.
The sole seller of the shares is Bouygues SA which holds 99.99 percent of Bouygues Offshore. Bouygues Offshore will not receive any of the proceeds from the share sale.
Bouygues Offshore is a leading international contractor serving the oil and gas industry while parent Bouygues is a major construction company.
Shares will start quoting in Paris at 1430 GMT on Thursday. The American Depositary Shares (ADS) will start trading on the New York Stock Exchange at 0930 local time under the ticker symbol BWG.
Lehman Brothers is acting as global coordinator of the initial public offering.

Bouygues Offshore generated turnover of 3.4 billion francs in 1995 and has said it expects the company's 1996 net attributable profit to be stable or slightly below the 171 million francs it posted for 1995.
